questions.question: What did Moses tell Israel to do with the places where the nations they were driving out served their gods?
Moses said the LORD would choose a place among Israel's tribes for worship. What would the LORD establish that place as?
Why did Moses tell Israel not to eat the blood of an animal?

answers.text: The blood belongs to the priests
The blood makes the meat unclean

questions.question: Moses ended by telling Israel to do everything he commanded. What else did he say about those commands?

answers.text: Not to add to them or subtract from them
To change them when the times change
To keep the parts that fit them best
